title: Association strength of E6 to E6AP/p53 complex correlates with HPV-mediated oncogenesis risk.
authors: Ferraz, Matheus Vitor Ferreira; Viana, Isabelle Freire Tabosa; Coelho, Danilo Fernandes; da Cruz, Carlos Henrique Bezerra; de Arruda Lima, Maira; de Luna Aragao, Madson Allan; Lins, Roberto Dias
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子模拟和机器学习评估HPV E6蛋白与E6AP/p53复合物的结合强度与致癌风险关联，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白复合物而非TF-DNA互作，但方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is recognized as the causative agent of cervical cancer in women, and it is associated with other anogenital and head/neck cancers. More than 120 types of HPV have been identified and many classified as high- or low-risk according to their oncogenic potential. One of its proteins, E6, has evolved to overcome the oncosuppressor functions of p53 by targeting this protein for degradation via interaction with the human ubiquitin-ligase E6AP. This study evaluates the correlation between the association strength of 40 HPV E6 types to the E6AP/p53 complex and the HPV oncogenesis risk using molecular simulations and machine and deep learning (ML/DL). In addition, a ML/DL-driven prediction is proposed for the HPV unclassified oncogenic risk type. The results indicate that thermodynamics play a pivotal role in the establishment of HPV-associated cancer and highlight the need to include some viral types in the HPV-related cancer surveillance and prevention strategies.
abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）被公认为女性宫颈癌的致病因子，并与其它肛门生殖器及头颈部癌症相关。已鉴定出超过120种HPV类型，并根据其致癌潜力将其中的许多类型分为高风险或低风险。其蛋白之一E6已进化出通过与人泛素连接酶E6AP相互作用，靶向p53蛋白进行降解，从而克服p53的肿瘤抑制功能。本研究利用分子模拟及机器与深度学习（ML/DL），评估了40种HPV E6类型与E6AP/p53复合物的结合强度与HPV致癌风险之间的相关性。此外，提出了一种基于ML/DL的预测方法，用于HPV未分类致癌风险类型。结果表明，热力学在HPV相关癌症的发生中起关键作用，并强调需将某些病毒类型纳入HPV相关癌症监测与预防策略中。
